job: Centre one task on a page of its own, outside the shell.
purpose: A centred column at a readable width for sign in, a second step, consent or a result. The brand leads, one card holds the task, and one quiet line closes it. Navigation stays off these screens. For a result such as link sent or signed out, lead with a 44px tile whose tone says what happened.
useWhen: The person does one thing before entering the app: sign in, verify, consent, finish a flow.
A result stands alone: link sent, signed out, run stopped.

avoidWhen.when: The page is something people return to; it belongs in the shell.
A first-run flow with several screens and progress.
A confirmation of one action over the page.

variants.useWhen: A wider column for a screen with more to read, such as consent.

parts.role: Centres the heading and its line.
One small centred line under the card, or inside it for a last word.
